name: Seeded fall
visual_intent: Falling spice, dust or confetti that is identical on every render.

timeline_requirements.gsap_instance: Timeline passed to Studio.build(builder) (registered as window.__timelines['root'])
timeline_requirements.timing_anchors: Cue map (Studio.cues) from storyboard.json or measured narration (audio/timeline.json)

code_snippet.javascript:
const ps = Studio.draw.particles(svg, 24, 9, {box});
Studio.draw.drift(tl, ps, 5, 7.5, {dy: 220, jitterX: 30});

fallbacks: Fall back to the approved zero-dip crossfade or a plain fromTo opacity/transform tween if the effect reads badly in a format.
validation_steps: python scripts/frame-review.py <project> --fonts google (inspect contact sheets per format)
npx hyperframes check on the render host; then hyperframes snapshot at the effect's start, middle and end

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test tests/test-studio-runtime.py and frame review of projects/masala-chai-recipe (landscape, portrait, square) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30. Not yet rendered through HyperFrames on the Apple M2 host, so not approved.
